plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's growth. The trine lets them flow together easily.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their sense of identity, confidence, and direction work smoothly with your judgment about what's possible. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: Support only matters if you do something with it. This person may believe in you, encourage you, and remind you of what is possible, but their faith cannot build your life for you. The gift here is confidence. The work is turning that confidence into action.
advice: Let this person's belief in you push you forward. Their encouragement can build your confidence, but it only matters if you act on it. This connection works best when hope is backed by effort and growth is supported by consistent action.
summaryShort: Their sense of identity, confidence, and direction work smoothly with your judgment about what's possible.
